title: agent-fs skill journey
description: How the skill tells a coding agent to work through a code base with afs, over a session.

entities.name: Explore and re-read code with afs
entities.description: From the first look at a code base to re-reading files that changed, spending as few context tokens as the replies allow.
entities.goal: Find and read the code it needs, and keep up with changes, without re-reading what it already has.

stages.context: Starting work where afs is installed.
stages.touchpoint: The afs_* tools of `afs serve` through MCP, or one `afs jsonl` process
stages.action: Uses the afs tools instead of shell reads; without MCP, starts `afs jsonl` once and pipes one request per line, since `afs call` has no session memory.
stages.outcome: One session that remembers what it has sent.

stages.context: Looking for where something is defined or used.
stages.touchpoint: afs_outline, or afs_search with files_only or fields: ["line"]
stages.action: Asks for an outline or a compact search first.
stages.outcome: [start, end, kind, name] rows per symbol, or file lists and bare line numbers.

stages.action: Reads only the ranges it needs, such as [[start, end]] from an outline row.
stages.outcome: Just those lines, with the file's etag.

stages.context: Asking again for something it was already sent.
stages.action: Takes the content from its earlier result rN instead of asking again; passes fresh: true only if it lost that result.
stages.outcome: No tokens spent on content it already holds.

stages.context: Re-reading a whole file that changed, for instance after an edit.
stages.action: Applies the hunks to its copy from the last `at` to the first (at = old line, del = lines removed, ins = new text).
stages.outcome: The current file without reading it again in full.

stages.action: Continues with next_ranges or next_cursor, or narrows the query, rather than raising the caps blindly.
stages.outcome: The rest of what it needs, in bounded pieces.

relatedViews.relationship: find-and-read-item carries the orient and read-ranges stages; reread-changed-file carries repeat and changed.
The unchanged, diff and bounded-output features the stages rely on.
